activity_summary: At the end plot the frame lay pegged, green oak almost yellow, four bays. Twelve men, poles and two ropes. You took a foot with Richard and the first cross-frame went up sweetly. Sadler said your twenty shillings was already in the timber, and the ale after was his cousin's. You were told to take the next foot the same way, from the legs.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Lifted the first foot from the legs, and said he would take the next the same way.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the foot with him, and forbade talk during the lift.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Directed the square of it from the ladder.

entities.name: Hamnet Sadler
entities.context: Counted the twelve, named the four bays, and kept the ale off William's account.

topics: the twenty shillings in the timber

quotes.speaker: hamnet_sadler
quotes.text: Green oak, near as yellow as a new deal, four bays

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare
quotes.text: From the legs. Say nothing while she goes.

quotes.speaker: hamnet_sadler
quotes.text: Your twenty shillings is in her, Will.

quotes.speaker: hamnet_sadler
quotes.text: Sweet. That is how a bay should go
